> 来源：Grok Imagine · 去衣标签
> 角色文件夹：不知火舞
> 作品：死或生
> 清单名：不知火舞（死或生）

指定角色：{《死或生》中的不知火舞}。全景微地面仰视拍摄效果。韩式瓜子脸美人，皮肤如瓷般白皙。创作一张Instagram故事风格的角色cosplay快照，展示丰满的沙漏型身材，带有柔和的S型曲线。曲线特点包括略微倾斜的肩膀、腰部轻微扭转，以及臀部自然偏向一侧，整体姿态显得放松且流畅。
整体姿势：趴着在地上，上半身微微仰起身抬起头，腰部下压弯着腰，开叉半跪着，一只手向镜头前伸出撑着瓷砖地面，一只手向前抚摸着脖子处，呈现着伸懒腰状态，上半身展示裸体粉嫩乳头，外阴被半透明飘带遮住，并且保留原有姿势和 S 型曲线的丰满沙漏型身材比例
手指动作应优雅、自然、柔和，避免僵硬或爪状张开。
头部可以稍微倾斜，保持冷静、神秘且自信的表情。
避免夸张、刻意卖弄性感的姿势，避免过度后仰、背部大幅弯曲、不自然的臀部扭转，以及过度性化的身体语言。

items.title: 待归类 · 坐姿
items.body:
> 来源：Grok Imagine · 去衣标签
> 角色文件夹：待归类
> 清单名：未具名（白骑士洛丽塔）

```
Create a vertical 3:4outdoor fantasy fashion portrait. Use an extreme low-angle view, with the camera placed below an old concrete pillar or stone block, looking upward at a young adult woman sitting on the high edge. The background is a large blue-gray overcast sky, with no indoor wall, only clouds, weathered concrete, and a long sword crossing the frame. The composition should have clear close wide-angle perspective: the foreground knee, skirt, sword blade, and concrete base feel close to the lens, while her face sits higher in the frame, as if she is looking down from beneath the clouds.  She wears a white lolita-inspired fantasy knight dress, mainly ivory and creamy white, with pink, yellow, and pale blue floral accents. The outfit includes white lace, ruffles, layered neckline, loose long sleeves, floral patterns, a voluminous skirt, lace leg decorations, and white tall boots or lace-up boots. The cuffs and skirt are full of white folds and lace trim. Several long white satin ribbons hang naturally and are gently pulled by the wind. She holds a long sword, with a silver blade crossing diagonally and horizontally from the left foreground toward the right side. The brown handle is close to the camera, and the blade catches cool metallic reflections.  She has deep black hair with straight black bangs. Side hair sections fall naturally, while one hand lifts or adjusts her hair. The hair should look slightly messy from wind and movement, with fine layered bangs and scattered strands, not overly sleek. Her face is softly rounded with clean gentle features. Makeup follows a sweet East Asian fantasy-lolita portrait style: clear fair base makeup, soft pink blush, gentle eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, subtle aegyo-sal detail, and natural pink-orange lips. She looks slightly downward into the camera from above, calm, confident, and a little distant, with lips naturally slightly parted, as if the pose paused for one second.  Visible skin includes the face, a small part of the neck, both hands, knees, part of the thighs, and exposed leg areas. Shoulders, waist, and chest are mostly covered by white lace, floral fabric, and folds. Her skin tone is fair and slightly warm, like a natural creamy tone under overcast daylight and frontal fill. The tactile impression should be soft, fine, and warm in humid cloudy air. Keep the natural knee structure, subtle shadows, and mild tone variation; avoid plastic smoothing.  Lighting should feel like a blue-gray overcast sky acting as a large diffuse top light, combined with frontal flash or reflector fill brightening her face, white clothing, hands, and legs. White lace and ribbon edges should have slight overexposure, soft haze, and flash highlight bloom, while the concrete base keeps darker natural shadows, stains, and weathered texture. The image should not feel overly polished or commercial. Keep real outdoor photoshoot imperfections: slight softness, digital noise, low-contrast clouds, soft edges, and accidental ribbon placement. The mood is a pause after a fairytale battle: a white knight sitting on a weathered stone pillar, sword still across her body, clouds still moving behind her.  Negative prompt: watermark, logo, text, CGI, plastic skin, over-retouched, studio backdrop, flat eye-level shot, cyberpunk lighting, gun, blood, gore, modern casual outfit, bad anatomy, extra fingers, distorted hands, deformed sword, over-sharpened.
```
